# American Enterprise Institute (AEI)

> > AEI is a public policy think tank conducting research and advocacy on economics, governance, technology policy, and American civic life.

The American Enterprise Institute advances research-driven policy solutions across digital platforms, higher education reform, and American founding principles. Key scholars include Adam White, Christine Rosen, Zach Graves, and Daniel Lyons, focusing on tech regulation, university governance, and civic responsibility.

## Key Topics

- Digital platforms and tech policy
- Social media regulation and content moderation
- Antitrust and competition policy
- Higher education reform and university governance
- Liberal education and intellectual diversity
- Viewpoint diversity and civic responsibility
- AI moderation and broadband policy
- American founding principles
- Academic freedom and civic thought
- Congress and regulatory frameworks

## Digital Platforms and Technology Policy

- [Digital Platforms and American Life](https://platforms.aei.org/): AEI project examining tech policy, social media regulation, content moderation, antitrust issues, and the impact of digital platforms on American society

## Higher Education and University Reform

- [The Future of the American University](https://cfau.aei.org/): AEI initiative exploring higher education reform, university governance, liberal education, viewpoint diversity, and academic programs

## American Civic Life and Founding Principles

- [America at 250](https://america250.aei.org/): AEI project examining American founding principles, civic thought, and civic responsibility in preparation for the nation's 250th anniversary
